exposure: diabetes in pregnancy (pre-gestational diabetes, gestational diabetes, newly diagnosed diabetes)
cohort: The study included 234 women with pre-gestational diabetes, gestational diabetes, and newly diagnosed diabetes during pregnancy.
finding: The study found a high rate of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes among women with diabetes in pregnancy, including increased cesarean delivery, preterm birth, stillbirth, congenital anomalies, neonatal hypoglycemia, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: A high rate of cesarean delivery (66%) was observed among women with diabetes in pregnancy.
followup_time: Until mother and baby were discharged from the hospital after delivery.
